title: An Informal Email
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I am happy to hear from you. I am sorry I did not write last week, because I was very busy. How are you and your family?

Next Saturday I am going to the park with my friend Ali. Would you like to come with us? We can have a picnic and play football. Please write back soon!

questions.text: Why did the writer not write last week?
options: He did not have a phone.

questions.text: Where is the writer going next Saturday?
What does the writer probably want Anna to do?
options: Come to the park with them

questions.text: How does the writer feel about getting Anna's email?
options: He is happy to hear from her.
He is bored by her email.

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
feeling regret or apologising for something
a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park
to receive news or information from someone

paragraph_translations: Merhaba Anna, e-postan için teşekkürler! Senden haber almak beni mutlu etti. Geçen hafta yazmadığım için özür dilerim, çünkü çok meşguldüm. Sen ve ailen nasılsınız?
Gelecek cumartesi arkadaşım Ali ile parka gidiyorum. Bizimle gelmek ister misin? Piknik yapabilir ve futbol oynayabiliriz. Lütfen yakında yaz!
